items: Masla tay karein: masla aur us par asar dalne wale awamil samjhein, jaise grocery kharche ke liye khandan ka size, jagah ya aamdani.
Data jama karein: purana kharcha, khandan ke afraad ki tadaad aur doosre mutalliqa awamil.
Algorithm chunein: model banane ka tareeqa, jaise linear ya logistic regression.
Model train karein: use data se seekhne dein ta ke pesh-goi kare.
Model jaanchein: naye data par aazma kar dekhein ke kitni achhi pesh-goi karta hai.

blocks.text: Model behtar karne ke liye: zyada data points, khandan ka size ya khaas mauqe jaise mutalliqa awamil, naye data se baqaidagi se update, aur pesh-goi ko asal kharche se jaanchna (Tip).

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: customers banam earnings ke paanch nuqte line earnings = 100 + 40 x customers par, 22 customers par Rs 980 ki prediction aur chhatay din ka asal nuqta 1,250. Oopar daen: 1 se 6 ghante parhai ke pass/fail nuqton par S-shakal imkan ka curve. Neeche baen: paanch students ke Math aur English scores do K-means clusters mein, markaz x se. Neeche daen: model banane ke paanch qadam.
blocks.caption: Linear regression, logistic regression aur K-means (topic 5.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Phal ke stall ka data bilkul line earnings = 100 + 40 x customers par hai, to 22 customers par 980 rupay ki prediction, aur chhatay din model ne 28 customers ke liye 1,220 kaha jabke asal 1,250 the. Logistic model parhai ke ghanton ko pass hone ke imkan mein badalta hai jo 0 ke qareeb se 1 ke qareeb tak S-shakal mein barhta aur fail aur pass students ke darmiyan 0.5 paar karta hai; banaya gaya curve wazahati hai. K = 2 ke saath K-means Basim, Umer aur Maliha ko Math 78.3, English 65 ke markaz par, aur Anie aur Tallat ko Math 45, English 82.5 par jama karta hai. Model masla tay karne, data jama karne, algorithm chunne, train karne aur naye data par jaanchne se banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Linear regression jaisa bunyadi statistical model banane ke qadam bataiye, data jama karne, training aur jaanch samait (long question 2).
blocks.explanation: Sawal aur variables tay karein (phal ke stall ke liye: customers X, kamai Y). Qabil-e-aitbaar data jama karein, saaf karein aur plot kar ke dekhein ke rishta seedha lagta hai. Linear regression chunein aur train karein: data par baithne wala slope aur intercept dhoondein (yahan earnings = 100 + 40 x customers). Naye data par pesh-goi ko asal se mila kar jaanchein (28 customers: andaza 1,220, asal 1,250, ghalti 30) aur error ya accuracy metrics istemal karein; phir nateeja samjhein aur naya data aane par model update karein.

items: Paanch qadam: masla tay, data jama, algorithm chunna, train, naye data par jaanch.
